changes: Fixed the live preview appearing rotated sideways and stretched on phones whose camera reports its own rotation

Video cameras: VHS-C, Super 8 Movie, Mini DV, Neon Night
Stickers & text on photos (drag, pinch, rotate)

First release: 22 retro cameras with live filtered viewfinder
LED date stamp, random light leaks, film grain and halation

Fisheye / prism / star / soft lenses, double exposure, timer, flash, photo import
